facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: prohibition notice - work stopped during start-up after maintenance on P-4104

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage.

defences.finding: Control EMERGENCY_ISOLATION_ON_RELEASE: the emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment was in place but did not perform, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an organisational factor.
Control HYDROCARBON_TRANSFER_CONTROL: the controlled transfer of hydrocarbon between vessels was not in place, and the ICAM investigation classified this as a task or environmental condition.
Control SEAL_FACE_TEMPERATURE_ALARM: the seal-face high-temperature alarm and trip was in place but did not perform, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an organisational factor.

recommendations: Confirm at the next critical control verification that the emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment on P-4104, HX-4120 and M-4104 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in managing hydrocarbon transfer and storage, specifically transferring hydrocarbon between vessels. P-4104 (hydrocarbon transfer pumps) is in service for hydrocarbon transfer, single mechanical seal with pressurised barrier-fluid support. The task proceeded during start-up after maintenance while the emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment was in place but did not perform. The pressure energy involved is held as hydraulic accumulator, and the recorded presentation was jet release, stored-energy discharge, rupture.
response.summary: On 19 December 2021 a regulatory notice was issued concerning P-4104, HX-4120 and M-4104 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility following start-up after maintenance.
